step.title: Your Master CV
step.body: Drop a PDF, DOCX or LinkedIn data export. Boba reads it and suggests profile facts — nothing is saved until you confirm each one.
pick.files: PDF, DOCX, LinkedIn export ZIP, TXT, MD or CSV
paste.title: Or paste your CV text
import.running: Reading your CV… this can take a minute.
import.accepted: {accepted} fact(s) found. Review each one below.
import.acceptedWithDrops: {accepted} fact(s) found; {dropped} couldn't be traced to your CV and were left out.
import.empty: No new facts were found in that CV.
review.title: Review the suggested facts
review.hint: Each fact is shown exactly as your CV states it. Confirm it, edit it, or delete it — nothing enters your profile until you confirm.
item.editHint: Edit the wording if you like. Saving adds it to your profile as a new version.
